verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Appwrite ships an MCP *server* so external LLMs/agents can call into Appwrite's own API (appwrite-docs-11, appwrite-probe-3, appwrite-probe-6) — the reverse of what the story asks. There is no evidence that Appwrite itself can act as an MCP client/host that lets users plug in external MCP servers for it to consume their tools.
